Description: Separate memories can be allocated for RTP header and payload

Feature: Supports any type of RTP packet (Compressed, Uncompressed, audio etc.)
Description: No restriction on content of RTP payload
In addition to RTP, RTCP packets can also be received

Feature: Supports RTP payload directly in GPU memory
Description: Content of RTP payload can directly be in GPU memory. This can avoid copy if GPU processing of payload is required
RTP packets having uncompressed video as payload can be depacketized and converted to video frame as per SMPTE 2110-20 specification
RTP packets having uncompressed audio as payload can be depacketized and converted to audio frame as per SMPTE 2110-30 specification
RTP packets having fixed header and payload size can be depacketized to form a frame. In this mode headers will be removed and payloads will be combined to form a frame
By using Rivermax media API's, can receive redundant packets over independent network paths.

Receive SMPTE 291M ancillary data (e.g. CEA-608/708 closed captions) over ST 2110 networks. Depayloads RFC 8331 RTP packets into ST2038 wire-format buffers (one buffer per ANC packet). Activated by meta/x-st-2038 caps. RTP marker bit and timestamp are propagated to downstream buffers; SMPTE 2022-7 dual-path reception is supported.
